candidate_selection.scope: Own bounded heuristic, not a full IM or SplitMiner port; no general soundness or quality guarantee.

measurement_policy: Two repetitions are observations, not a statistical benchmark. Rust images include mining, conversion, export and evaluation; Java images mine/export. Counters cover one retained image, not a process tree. Python venv images are redirectors: interpreter CPU/RAM is NOT established by those counters; wall time includes waiting for child. Working set includes shared pages; private commit is distinct. No cross-scope speed or memory ranking.
